svg.title: One order question across ADK agents: coordinator, A2A specialists and MCP Toolbox
svg.text: One order question across ADK agents: coordinator, A2A specialists and MCP Toolbox
The coordinator plans with Gemini, calls the remote inventory and shipping agents over A2A in parallel, and the specialists read the database only through MCP Toolbox

g.data-label: Where is order 4711, and can we ship it today?
